speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are dealing with a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To begin my assessment, can you describe exactly where on your palms the rash is located and what color it appears?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (specifically cutaneous leishmaniasis with possible associated neuropathy or misattribution of symptoms due to systemic involvement).

I have noted your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, which increases the risk of exposure to sandflies or other vectors. Before we proceed, could you clarify if the "rash on your palms" is actually on your upper body and face as you mentioned earlier, and do you have any open sores or ulcers in those areas?
